verdict.rationale: Helicone supports event-driven automation via webhooks that fire when requests match ALL specified property conditions, alerts on error-rate/cost thresholds, and automatic fallback/rate-limit strategies triggered by request events (e.g., switching providers on outage or exceeding token limits) — all documented as rule-based triggers acting without app code changes. However, this is scattered across separate features (webhooks, alerts, gateway fallback) rather than a unified 'rules engine' with a rich condition/action builder, and there's no independent/hands-on evidence corroborating real-world reliability of these triggers. Missing for 10: a centralized rule-builder UI, richer condition types beyond property-matching, and community validation of automated-action reliability.
